headline: Electricity prices frozen through December; Taipower: company expects annual losses exceeding NT$70 billion | Industry news | Finance
summary: Taiwan's Ministry of Economic Affairs froze electricity prices from October to December at NT$3.7823 per kWh. Taipower expects annual losses exceeding NT$70 billion, and transmission rates are deferred to a December review.
why: Taipower is Taiwan's state-owned electricity utility, and its tariffs are set by government review. Frozen prices in the face of rising costs widen the utility's losses and can affect public finances.
